errors.evidence: The tick marks on the x-axis are not at regular intervals. They are placed at specific values such as 0.71, 0.73, 0.79, 0.82, etc.
The blue line for "Final Accuracy" does not show a general upward trend. It starts high (around 0.9), dips, and then fluctuates mostly in the 0.85-1.0 range.
The green line representing "Initial Accuracy" is dash-dotted, not dashed. The orange line is dashed.
The green line representing "Initial Accuracy" has square markers, not circular ones. The blue line has circular markers.

This description of the orange "Δ Accuracy" line omits its most prominent features, which are the large peaks at initial confidence values of approximately 0.92 (value ~0.4) and 0.94 (value ~0.45). It misleadingly suggests the line remains low after the initial drop.
The value for Δ Accuracy at an initial confidence of 0.73 is approximately 0.1. Describing this as "near 0.0" is an exaggeration on a 0.0 to 1.0 scale.
